lead.title: One shared plan
lead.description: Plans, milestones, tasks, and acceptance criteria live in one place. You and your agent read and write the same rows.

lead.title: One agent plans. Another builds.
lead.description: A planner writes the plan while an executor claims tasks, leaves a handoff, and links the commit.

lead.title: Proof where the work landed.
lead.description: Follow every task into commits, changed files, and pull requests. Missing proof is marked stale, never hidden.

support.title: A control room for what needs you
support.description: Health, drift, open questions, claims, and overlaps surface in one strip, so you know where to look.

support.title: Trust hubs, not a wall of text
support.description: Criteria, evidence, questions, references, and approvals are selectable hubs on every row.

support.title: Claims that prevent collisions
support.description: Leases, touch-points, and expiry keep parallel agents off each other's files.

support.title: Sessions and handoffs
support.description: Every run leaves a summary, a handoff, and comments, so the next agent can resume without a briefing.

support.title: An agent workbench
support.description: Run an ACP agent beside the plan. Approvals and staged proposals keep writes deliberate.

support.title: Source trail
support.description: Walk from task to repo, commit, changed file, and pull request. Missing proof is marked stale.

support.title: Timeline on demand
support.description: See plans and milestones across lanes without leaving the screen.

support.title: Keyboard-first
support.description: A fast tree, command palette, history, and bulk actions. The mouse is optional.

support.title: Three terminal themes
support.description: Mocha, void, and latte. The screen follows your terminal, not the other way around.

support.title: Local-first and private
support.description: SQLite on your machine, no account, no cloud. Export or import any time.

support.title: Writes are deliberate and recorded
support.description: The screen is read-only until you arm override; every write lands in the activity feed.

support.title: Find, mark, edit once
support.description: Filter the tree, mark rows, and apply bulk moves, blocks, and releases.
